title: RAW UNREVIEWED: keyed table with a source-written reversal of inputs and outputs
summary: Look for a historical table that explicitly writes both directions of a technical relation and labels its input and output columns, ideally with non-symmetric cases. Freeze the complete source table before target comparison. A candidate word reading on admitted text must distinguish the reversed roles, not simply match the same item inventory or count. No relevant table or manuscript binding has been verified.

design.mechanism: non-symmetric source table reversal independently keys relation direction and participant roles
design.unit: complete bidirectional source table and complete candidate target table or passage
design.contrast: direction-preserving word roles versus bag-of-items equivalence
design.prediction: frozen whole forms and positional constructions recover both source directions, including every non-symmetric cell
